mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals robust residential construction activity that precedes higher consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST increases by at least 1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 5.0%, it indicates a tightening labor market that accelerates consumer spending and corporate profit growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE is below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: The joint rise of federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals aggressive monetary tightening that compresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term between FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL has a Rank IC below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or negative returns fail in more than 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply shock (INDPRO decline exceeding 2% month-over-month), manufacturing output contraction reduces corporate margins and economic growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with INDPRO declining by at least 2% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reflects restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates for equity valuation, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS is above 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 2100 thousand units, it indicates strong residential demand that supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST is above 2100.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between payroll growth (PAYEMS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) forms a labor market strength index: when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, it signals robust job market conditions that boost consumer confidence and equity returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term between PAYEMS and UNRATE has a Rank IC below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or positive returns fail in more than 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 200), a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) amplifies the negative impact on equity valuations, causing S&P 500 returns to decline over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL > 200 and FEDFUNDS is above 4.0%.
